import sys,hashlib,json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace');sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp')
from wire import *
from harness import run
from canonref import hdr
def vw(val,width): return (([1,2,4,8].index(width)<<(8*width-2))|val).to_bytes(width,'big')
# payload raw and canonical pairs
raw=b'\x00\x00\x01'
can=b'\x00\x00\x01'
# ack type2 largest9 delay0 count1 first2 gap1 range3
raw+=b'\x02'+vw(9,2)+vw(0,4)+vw(1,8)+vw(2,2)+vw(1,4)+vw(3,8)
can+=b'\x02'+v(9)+v(0)+v(1)+v(2)+v(1)+v(3)
# crypto offset2 len3 abc
raw+=b'\x06'+vw(2,2)+vw(3,4)+b'abc'; can+=b'\x06'+v(2)+v(3)+b'abc'
# max data10
raw+=b'\x10'+vw(10,4);can+=b'\x10'+v(10)
# path challenge
raw+=b'\x1a'+bytes(range(8));can+=b'\x1a'+bytes(range(8))
# new cid seq1 rpt0 cid 2 xy token16
tok=bytes(range(16))
raw+=b'\x18'+vw(1,2)+vw(0,4)+b'\x02xy'+tok
can+=b'\x18'+v(1)+v(0)+b'\x02xy'+tok
# stream id0 off5 len3 def fin, overlong
raw+=b'\x0f'+vw(0,2)+vw(5,4)+vw(3,8)+b'def'
can+=b'\x0f'+v(0)+v(5)+v(3)+b'def'
w=envelope('A',0,raw,cid=b'\xbb',phase=0)
r=run(trace([{'keys':['A']},datagram(w,(0,))]))['traces'][0]
p=r['packets'][0]
exp=hdr('A',0,0,can)
print(p['status'],p['sha256'],hashlib.sha256(exp).hexdigest(),p['sha256']==hashlib.sha256(exp).hexdigest())
print('stream',r['streams'],'ack',r['acknowledged'][0],'crypto',r['crypto'][2],'peer',r['peer_cids'])
